text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Rhine Kraft made an 
unbelievably swift recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through repeated tests and rehabilitation, 
she has fully cleared the physical 
hurdles.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Is Craft doing well?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's no problem at all anymore.
Yeah, there's no problem at all anymore.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Back to how it was, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Triumph over fierce battles with the 
senior Tiara Umamusume, show them the back 
of the runner they admire. Leave behind a 
run of her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having wished for that, she realized she 
possessed the power to leave something 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Autumn is about to begin. Along with Line 
Craft's races, starting with the Sprinters 
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just the Sprint Queen— a 
whole court of queens waiting in line 
behind her wants a race with Craft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even with Cesario, treatment for her 
injury is going well, and she might make 
it in time for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
choice_data_list:
So you're not entering either of those 
races?

You're not running in either of those 
races?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. I'll just be spectating those 
two. Watching from the outside allows for 
a cooler analysis than being in the middle 
of it, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Laying down all kinds of groundwork is my 
path to victory. Understand?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Craft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching the Sprinters Stakes. And 
the entire journey you take after that, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...So, make sure you win, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I'll do my best. For your sake, as the 
one who accepted me.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (—So keep your eyes on me, okay?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Welcome, Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Welcome to our turf.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? Come—shall we whip the 
audience into a frenzy?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!
